T: Four voices. One stage. A lot of soul.
D: In 1968, four young Aboriginal women from a country mission form a soul group and tour Vietnam to sing for the troops.
P: Serve the mains when the Sapphires hit the stage for the troops in Vietnam.
S: Talent quest party pies and sauce
Bite-size beef pies in shortcrust with a thick gravy filling

Homemade bite-size beef and gravy party pies with flaky puff tops, baked golden and served hot with tomato sauce, just like the country pub. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes until thick, then cool. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and press into mini muffin tins. Fill, top with rounds cut from 2 sheets puff pastry, pinch the edges and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

Short crusty rolls spread with pâté and mayo, stuffed with roast pork, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Julienne 1 carrot and a small daikon and pickle in 100ml rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes. Rub 600g pork scotch fillet with fish sauce, garlic and honey and roast at 200C for 30 minutes, then rest and slice thin. Split 8 short crusty rolls and spread with 100g chicken liver pâté and mayonnaise. Fill with pork, drained pickles, cucumber, coriander and sliced chilli, and drizzle with soy.
Warm baked damper bread with butter and golden syrup
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, served warm with butter and golden syrup.
M: Clear beef broth spiced with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon, over rice noodles and thin rare beef, with herbs, lime, chilli and bean sprouts. Char 1 halved onion and a thumb of ginger in a dry pan. Simmer 1.5kg beef bones with the onion, ginger, 4 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 3 litres water for 4 hours, skimming. Strain and season with 3 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar. Soak 400g flat rice noodles. Slice 300g beef eye fillet paper thin. Put noodles and raw beef in bowls, pour over boiling broth and serve with Thai basil, mint, bean sprouts, lime and chilli.
Topside roast with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and pan gravy
Beef topside seasoned and roasted at 200C to 52C, rested and carved thin, with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and a gravy made in the roasting tin with flour and stock.
W: Butter sponge squares dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in coconut

Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, set on a rack. Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.
K: Strong coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and ice, Vietnamese style

Strong dark coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice. Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.

note.text: Girls, you sing soul and those boys over there need it. Eat first, then take the stage.

winks: Dave Lovelace as the band's manager

dishes.n: Talent quest party pies and sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mince and onion, stir in the flour, Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 24 rounds from the shortcrust and press into mini muffin tins.
Fill, top with rounds of puff pastry, pinch the edges and brush with egg.
Bake until golden and serve hot with tomato sauce.
Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the butter into the flour and salt.
Mix in the milk with a knife until just combined.
Shape, score and bake.
Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.
Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes and pumpkin in oil.
Cook the peas.
Stir the flour into the roasting tin, add the stock and simmer into gravy.
Heat the oven to 180C and line a tin. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Bake the sponge and cool.
Cut into cubes.
Mix the icing sugar, cocoa and a little milk into icing.
Dip each cube in icing and roll in coconut.
Set on a rack.
Brew very strong coffee.
Put the condensed milk in 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir.
Fill with ice and serve straight away.
